name: Femboy Simulator
source: Atmospheric visual novel set around a mysterious coffee shop. Observe, interact, and uncover subtle changes as you piece together a quiet, unsettling story through environment, dialogue, and mood-driven moments
translation: 一部围绕一家神秘咖啡馆展开的氛围系视觉小说。仔细观察、与之互动并发掘细微的异变，在环境细节、人物对话与情绪渲染的片段中，一步步拼凑出一段静谧而又令人不安的故事。
